morning.insight:
💡 전일 브리핑의 경고가 현실이 된 하루

"아마존·인텔 시간외 폭락 → 오늘 아시아 증시 변동성 예고"가 그대로 적중했습니다. KOSPI -3.48%, 반도체 지수 -7.2%, 인텔 시총 1,200억 달러 증발. AI 인프라 투자에 대한 시장의 '회의론'이 단순 조정이 아니라 구조적 재평가로 번질지가 관건입니다.

하지만 지난주와 다른 점도 있습니다. SK하이닉스는 직전 거래일 10.89% 급등하며 영업이익 2.6조 호실적을 기록했습니다. 이번 하락은 '기업가치 하락'보다는 'AI 인프라 과잉투자 우려'에 따른 평가 조정에 가깝습니다. 인텔의 타격이 하이닉스·삼성까지 확장된 것은 과도한 측면이 있어 주중 반등 가능성을 열어둘 필요가 있습니다.

토요일 — 골프와 가족이 먼저입니다. 밀린 프로젝트가 많지만 오전에 재무계획 취합(전략회의 D-3) 1~2시간만 정리하고, 오후는 골프, 저녁은 어머님 생신에 집중하세요. 시장 변동성이 클수록 일상의 리듬을 지키는 게 장기적으로 이깁니다. 즐거운 토요일 보내세요.

articles.headline: Top Military Admiral Briefs Trump on Iran Options
articles.body: The top U.S. military officer briefed President Trump on options for striking Iran, as crude prices rose toward $103 a barrel on renewed conflict risk in the region.

articles.headline: The Five Whirlwind Days That Brought Down Weil Gotshal
articles.body: The storied law firm Weil Gotshal collapsed after a five-day run of losses, with leadership telling partners the firm should be dissolved.

articles.headline: Alphabet Shares Slide as Search Revenue Growth Slows
articles.body: Alphabet fell as slowing search-revenue growth overshadowed a surge in Google Cloud, dragging tech shares lower and reviving AI-spending worries.

articles.headline: Oil Rises Toward $103 on Iran Strike Risk
articles.body: Crude oil climbed toward $103 a barrel on signals the U.S. may resume military strikes against Iran, stoking concern over energy flows in the region.

articles.headline: Treasury Yields Hold Near 4.93% as Markets Digest Earnings
articles.body: The 10-year Treasury yield held near 4.93% as investors weighed a resilient U.S. economy against a wave of Big Tech earnings misses.

articles.headline: Apple Overtakes Nvidia to Become World's Most Valuable Company
articles.body: Apple reclaimed the title of the world's most valuable company from Nvidia as the AI-chip rout deepened, marking a rotation away from the semiconductor trade.

articles.headline: Big Tech's Deepening AI Funding Concerns Sink Asian Chip Stocks
articles.body: Asian chip stocks tumbled as concerns over Big Tech's AI spending intensified, with Samsung and SK Hynix leading losses in Seoul.

articles.headline: Meta, Alphabet, Intel Share Sales Leave Buyers Far Underwater
articles.body: Recent share sales by Meta, Alphabet and Intel have left buyers deeply underwater as the AI trade unwinds, deepening losses across the technology sector.

articles.headline: AI Dip-Buyers Gored as Selling Spasm Caps Third Week of Losses
articles.body: Investors who bought the AI dip were hit hard as a selling spasm capped a third straight week of losses, shaking confidence in the megacap rally.

articles.headline: Big Tech Holds $3 Trillion in Spending Commitments for AI Boom
articles.body: Big Tech companies hold roughly $3 trillion in spending commitments tied to the AI boom, a figure that is fueling investor concern about returns.

articles.headline: AI Credit Risk Gauges Hit New Records on Supply, Profit Concerns
articles.body: Credit-default protection costs for technology firms hit new records as supply-chain and profit concerns deepened the AI selloff.

articles.headline: Binance's $6.3 Billion Hack Is Just the Start of a Risky New Era
articles.body: The theft of about $6.3 billion from Binance — one of the largest crypto heists ever — is raising alarms about security in the digital-asset industry, with North Korea-linked hackers suspected.

articles.headline: Traffic Control Errors Caused Spain's Deadly Train Crash, Official Says
articles.body: Investigators said traffic-control errors caused the high-speed train crash in Spain that killed at least 69 people, focusing on the signaling systems involved.

articles.headline: Economy Grows at Fastest Pace in a Year
articles.body: U.S. gross domestic product rose 3.4 percent in the third quarter, the fastest in a year, driven by robust business investment and consumer spending.

articles.headline: Big Tech's Selloff Deepens as Intel and Amazon Disappoint
articles.body: Intel and Amazon both fell sharply after results that missed expectations, deepening a selloff driven by worries that AI spending is outrunning returns.

articles.headline: They Bought Harry Houdini's House. It Came With a Gaggle of Magic Fans.
articles.body: The new owners of Houdini's Harlem brownstone discovered that the famed magician's home still draws a steady stream of devoted fans.

articles.headline: Alphabet Shares Slide as Search Growth Slows
articles.body: Alphabet dropped after its third-quarter report showed slowing growth in core search, clouding optimism over its AI business even as cloud revenue surged.

articles.headline: The Trouble With Uncle Sam's Intel Shares
articles.body: The U.S. government lost about $12 billion as Intel's stock fell 29 percent, its worst day since 1974, highlighting the risks of Washington's equity stakes.

articles.headline: Oil Giants Report Windfall Profits as High Gas Prices Loom Over the Election
articles.body: Oil companies reported windfall profits days before a midterm election dominated by voter anger over inflation and energy costs.

articles.headline: Democrats Say the Economy Will Give Them Control of the House
articles.body: Democrats are betting that voter frustration over costs for housing, health care and groceries will hand them control of the House in the midterms.

articles.headline: Are American Voters Actually Gloomy About the Economy?
articles.body: Despite strong growth, rising electricity, health-care and housing costs are squeezing households, shaping a cost-of-living backlash ahead of the midterms.

articles.headline: Strong Growth and Inflation Paints Mixed Picture of Economy Days Before Midterms
articles.body: Solid GDP growth alongside stubborn inflation is giving voters a mixed economic picture in the final days before the midterm elections.

articles.headline: Meet Hasan Piker, the Streamer Dividing Democrats in the Midterms
articles.body: The Twitch streamer has become a polarizing force in the midterms, energizing young voters while unnerving establishment Democrats.

articles.headline: US Tech Stocks Tumble as Concerns Over AI Spending Intensify
articles.body: US technology stocks tumbled as earnings fueled growing concern that the AI spending boom may be running ahead of returns, with Intel and Amazon slumping.

articles.headline: Alphabet Shares Tumble in $500bn Rout
articles.body: Alphabet shares fell sharply as slowing search growth raised questions about how AI will reshape its core business, in a rout that wiped out about $500 billion in value.

articles.headline: Binance Rushes to Recover Customer Money After $6.3bn Heist
articles.body: Binance moved to recover customer funds after a $6.3 billion heist, one of the largest in crypto history, with North Korea-linked hackers suspected.

articles.headline: US Economy Beats Forecasts to Grow at 3.4% Rate in Third Quarter
articles.body: US growth accelerated to a 3.4% annualized pace in the third quarter, powered by business investment and consumer spending, easing near-term recession fears.

articles.headline: French Economy Shrinks 0.1% in Third Quarter
articles.body: France's economy contracted 0.1% in the third quarter amid protests, even as the wider eurozone grew faster than expected, stoking stagflation worries.

articles.headline: What Killed Weil Gotshal?
articles.body: The collapse of Weil Gotshal has shaken the legal industry, as the once-mighty firm's leadership moved toward dissolving the partnership.
